_doc: The WeChat account list (ct-src, 2026-10-24); supersedes wechat-accounts-2026-10-22.json, which stays as the record of that round. An account is re-resolved by Dajiala before its first read: from verified_url when it is a link that names the account (__biz or short /s/ form), else by its nickname — the first of expected_names — kept only when the answered nickname is expected and every post carries biz (when known). The 2026-10-22 seed links of 44 accounts were Sogou temporary links (src=11/src=3, timestamp, signature) that had expired before the first read; they are dropped (seed_link_expired) and those accounts resolve by name. group: industry, clinical, society-journal, hospital, regulator, research-media. priority 1 (regulators, journals, societies; read twice a day) is spent first, then 2 (clinical portals, hospitals), 3 (industry and research media), 4 (the rest).
